YOUR SPECIAL OCCASION DESTINATION

The Morsel Restaurant is a well-known food business brand, located in the city of Vadodara, for the last two decades. The restaurant is popular for its Food and Service, Dining Space, Good Ambience & Hospitality.

Bite of Happiness

We see our customers as invited guests to a party, and we are the hosts. It’s our job every day to make every important aspect of the customer experience a little bit better.

OUR SPECIALITY

Paneer Butter Masala

Morsel Restaurant’s Paneer Sabji features soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, spiced tomato-onion gravy. Infused with traditional North Indian spices, it’s a flavorful, comforting dish best enjoyed with butter naan or steamed basmati rice. A true classic.

Vegetable Hakka Noodles

Vegetable Hakka Noodles are a delicious Indo-Chinese favorite, stir-fried with fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and aromatic spices. Perfectly tossed for flavor and crunch, this savory noodle dish is a crowd-pleaser that’s spicy, satisfying, and full of flavor.

Vegetable Dum Biryani

Morsel Restaurant’s Vegetable Dum Biryani is a flavorful, aromatic rice dish layered with fresh vegetables, fragrant spices, and herbs. Slow-cooked to perfection, this classic North Indian specialty offers a rich, hearty taste that’s both satisfying and unforgettable.
